title: BYRLAW
text: BYRLAW, or ŁyrŁLAW laws, in Scotland, are made and determined by neighbours, elected by common conferin byterw courts. The man chaden in judges are called byrlaw or burlaw men, and take cognizance of complaints between neighbors and neighbors.
